aToB.memory: Sharing Potions Class with Finn means Dorian has gotten used to dodging an enchanted brass camera whenever a beaker bubbles unexpectedly. Because Finn constantly chases lurid 'Starlight Tower necromancer' rumors, Dorian enjoys feeding him wildly polite, deadpan nonsense just to watch Finn try fact-checking it later.
aToB.nextConversationGoal: Dorian wants to ward off Finn's inevitable interrogation about Leo Vance with dry, straight-faced misdirection before Potions Class and find out what wild theories the campus paper is already printing.

bToA.memory: Finn has learned the hard way that Dorian's calm expression looks identical whether he's giving genuine spirit-audit advice or inventing an outrageous joke about haunted broom closets. Still, as Leo Vance's literal Starlight Tower roommate, Dorian is suddenly the single hottest quote on Yozakura's campus.
bToA.nextConversationGoal: Finnian wants to catch Dorian between Potions Class and the dorms with coffee-shop bribery, promise not to exaggerate his quote too badly, and pry out at least one real detail about what Leo Vance is like behind closed doors.
